_for: ㅋㅋ상회 AI 공감짤 시안 5개 (2026-11-21). 글씨는 humor-cards render_photo_reel.py로 얹는다.
style: Soft hand-drawn Korean webtoon illustration, warm pastel colors, clean thin lineart, gentle cozy lighting, cute expressive original characters with big readable facial expressions, simple uncluttered background so the subject reads instantly on a phone. Original characters only, do not imitate any existing franchise or real person. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, signs with writing, or logos anywhere in the image.

prompts.name: kk_01_buttons
prompts.prompt: A tired young Korean office worker in a white shirt and loose tie sits at his desk at 5:55pm, sweating nervously, staring down at two big arcade-style push buttons on the desk in front of him, one bright red and one bright blue. His hand hovers between them. Behind him, slightly blurred, a stern middle-aged manager peeks out of a glass office door and beckons with one finger. Warm late-afternoon light through the window, office clock on the wall with no numbers.

prompts.name: kk_02_haircut
prompts.prompt: Cafe scene. A young woman with a fresh short bob haircut sits across a small table, chin on her hands, smiling expectantly with sparkly eyes, clearly waiting for a compliment. Across from her, her boyfriend freezes mid-sip of iced coffee, eyes wide, sweat drop on his temple, panicking because he cannot tell what changed. Comedic tension, soft afternoon light.

prompts.name: kk_03_friday
prompts.prompt: Friday night, 11pm. A young woman lies on her stomach in bed under a fluffy blanket, legs kicking happily in the air, smiling blissfully at her phone screen glowing on her face. Snacks and a can of soda on the bed, a warm bedside lamp, a dark window with city lights. A phone alarm clock on the nightstand is lying face down. Pure carefree weekend mood.

prompts.name: kk_04_hamster
prompts.prompt: A very cute chubby golden hamster sitting upright, holding out one single small round cookie toward the viewer with both tiny paws, big shiny pleading eyes, but with obvious cookie crumbs all around its mouth and stuffed puffy cheeks. Behind it, an empty torn snack box lies on its side. Soft pastel background, close-up, adorable and guilty expression.

prompts.name: kk_05_lunch
prompts.prompt: Office lunchtime on a busy street with restaurant fronts (signs left blank). Three young Korean coworkers stand in a group; two of them look exhausted and annoyed at the third coworker, who shrugs with a carefree smile and both palms up as if saying anything is fine, while a thought cloud above his head shows only a frowning face crossing out a bowl of noodles. Bright midday light, comedic expressions.
